requirements: R1: The application container must start successfully and respond to health checks at port 18080.

slices.title: Fix wildcard JAR copy in Dockerfile
slices.jtbd: When implementing the Dockerfile fix for this epic, I want to copy the specific executable JAR file instead of a wildcard, so that the application container launches successfully and responds to health checks.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the Dockerfile build process,
When the container is built and launched,
Then the specific executable JAR is copied as app.jar and the /health endpoint on port 18080 returns a successful response.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce runtime health check failures from 1 to 0
